findings.title: Keep the no-stack original error in the stack fallback test
findings.trigger: The test 'creates new stack if original error has no stack' now builds `original` with `new Error('original')`, which always has a `stack`.
findings.impact: `GraphQLError` takes the `originalError.stack` branch, the same as the preceding test, so the name no longer matches what runs and a regression in the no-stack fallback path with an original error would go unnoticed.
findings.change: In `src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js`, give `original` no `stack` again, for example keep the plain `{ message: 'original' }` object typed `any`, so the fallback branch stays exercised under Flow.

observations.fact: The implementation signature of `GraphQLError` still types `nodes` without `null`, while the `declare class` above it now allows it; runtime already handles `null`.

requirements.evidence: src/error/GraphQLError.js:25 adds `| null` to `nodes`; GraphQLError-test.js calls the constructor with `null` nodes
